subject: Upcoming Company Event: Annual Employee Recognition Ceremony
body: Dear Team Members, We are thrilled to announce that the Annual Employee Recognition Ceremony will be held on Friday, December 10th, at the Grand Ballroom. This event is a special opportunity to celebrate the hard work and dedication of our employees over the past year. The ceremony will include awards, dinner, and entertainment. Please RSVP by November 30th to secure your spot. We look forward to honoring and celebrating our amazing team together! Sincerely, HR Department
